description: List the event's forms (call for papers, registration, sponsor intake, portal, and custom) with status and submission counts by pipeline status. Use it to find a formId before list_submissions, set_submission_status, or update_form. Returns forms[] with formId, title, status, isActive, and submissionCounts, plus truncated.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: list_forms

status.description: Form status, e.g. draft or active.

capped.description: True when counting stopped at its cap.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
